descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this outstanding red dissectum must be seen to be appreciated. Description will hardly do it justice. It is one of the most finely cut lace-leaved maples. The uniform color is a deep purple red or maroon. The foliage retains this color extremely well throughout the entire growing season. In the fall, it becomes a bright crimson. The leaves are seven lobed. However, each lobe is extremely lacy, being more delicately dissected than the type. The lobes are extremely pinnatifid, with the center of the lobe being no wider than the midrib—1 mm or lobes lying close together, the effect is certainly filigreelike. The leaves measure 6-8 cm long and 7-9 cm wide. The petioles are stiff and 1-2 cm long. The growth has the pendulous habit of the dissectums and is sturdy in spite of the fineness of some twigs. The overall effect is one of extreme beauty. The rate of growth is not quite as fast as in other dissectums. This cultivar is considered one of the most beautiful and unusual introductions of the Dissectum Group. It was a chance seedling grown by William Curtis of Sherwood, Oregon, from seed of a dissectum in his garden. As a yearling, it was given to William Goddard of Victoria, British Columbia. Goddard cultured and nurtured the plant for a number of years and finally sold it to John Mitsch of Aurora, Oregon. In the late 1980s, the plants and ownership were transferred to Iseli Nursery, Boring, Oregon, which built up stock and distributed it to growers and collectors. Iseli Nursery found stick budding was the best way to propagate this cultivar because of the smallness and thinness of the scion material. It was very fortunate this plant was not lost, for it adds greatly to this magnificent series of cultivars.

rhs.description: A compact, weeping shrub with finely feathered pinkish-red foliage in spring, changing to darker purple in the summer and maroon-red in the autumn. Particularly suitable for containers due to its compact habit

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑的垂枝灌木，春季叶片细致如羽，呈粉红偏红色，夏季转为较深的紫色，秋季则为栗红色。因株形紧凑，尤其适合容器栽培。

attributes.suggested_uses: 适合建筑感种植、城市/庭院花园、乡村式/自然式花园、低维护花园、露台/容器栽培及岩石园
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一杰出的红叶羽裂品种，其叶片之美须亲眼所见方能体会，文字描述难尽其妙。它是最精细裂叶的 lace-leaved maple 之一。整体叶色均匀，为深紫红色或栗酒红色，并且在整个生长季中都能极好地保持这种色彩。秋季则转为鲜亮深红色。叶片为 7 裂，但每一裂片都极其纤细蕾丝状，比典型类型分裂得更为细密。裂片深羽状分裂，裂片中央宽度几乎不超过中脉，仅约 1 mm；各细裂小片彼此贴近时，整体效果极具金银丝工般的精致感。叶长 6–8 cm，宽 7–9 cm。叶柄坚挺，长 1–2 cm。植株具 Dissectum Group 典型的下垂生长习性，尽管部分小枝十分纤细，但整体仍较健壮。其总体观感极为优美。生长速度略慢于其他羽裂品种。该品种被认为是 Dissectum Group 中最美丽且最不寻常的引种之一。它是俄勒冈州 Sherwood 的 William Curtis 用自家花园中一株羽裂枫的种子培育出的偶然实生苗。幼苗一岁时被赠予不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚的 William Goddard。Goddard 栽培养护多年后，最终将其售予俄勒冈州 Aurora 的 John Mitsch。20 世纪 80 年代末，这一品种的植株与所有权转移至俄勒冈州 Boring 的 Iseli Nursery，后者扩繁库存并分发给种植者和收藏者。Iseli Nursery 发现，由于接穗材料细小而薄，贴枝芽接是繁殖该品种的最佳方法。幸而这一植株未曾失传，因为它极大丰富了这一卓越的品种系列。‘Ruby Lace’ 与 ‘Red Filigree Lace’ 极为相似，几乎难以辨别两者之间是否存在差异。‘Red Filigree Lace’ 的另一个名称是 ‘Red Lace’。
